sloka: तदा प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ पितृ देवाः समागताः ।अफलान् भुंजते मेषान् फलैः तेषाम् अयोजयन् ॥१-४९-९॥
transliteration: tadā prabhṛti kākutstha pitṛ devāḥ samāgatāḥ ।aphalān bhuṁjate meṣān phalaiḥ teṣām ayojayan ॥1-49-9॥

translations.english: "O Son of the Kakutsthas from then on the pitrudevatas have been accepting rams without testicles as offerings in a sacrifice, with ram's testicles fitted on to Indra.
